text.Sigorta Teklifi: Kasko, Trafik, DASK, Sa: Insurance Quotes: Comprehensive Car (Kasko), Traffic, DASK, Health and Life - KredimGeldi
text.Kaskodan DASK'a, sağlıktan hayat sigorta: From comprehensive car insurance (kasko) to DASK, from health to life insurance, learn about the coverage you need and request a quote with a single form.
text.Kaskodan DASK'a, sağlıktan hayata ihtiya: From kasko to DASK, from health to life, learn about the insurance you need and request a quote with a single form.
text.Zorunlu ve isteğe bağlı sigortalar bir a: Mandatory and optional insurance in one place
text.İhtiyacına uygun teminat önerisi: Coverage recommendations tailored to your needs
text.Tek formla teklif talebi: Quote request with a single form
text.Hangi sigortalara ihtiyacın var?: Which types of insurance do you need?
text.Sana uyanları seç: Select the ones that apply to you
text.Özel hastaneleri kullanmak istiyorum: I want to use private hospitals
text.Durumuna uyan seçenekleri işaretle, sana: Check the options that fit your situation, and we'll list the insurance that suits you.
text.Bazı sigortalar yasal olarak zorunludur,: Some types of insurance are required by law, while others protect you and your loved ones from unexpected expenses.
text.Kazada karşı tarafa verdiğin maddi ve be: Covers the property damage and bodily injury you cause to the other party in an accident. Mandatory for every vehicle on the road.
text.Kaza, hırsızlık, yangın ve doğal afetler: Covers damage to your own vehicle from accidents, theft, fire and natural disasters.
text.Depremin ve deprem kaynaklı yangın, patl: Covers damage to your building caused by earthquakes and earthquake-related risks such as fire and explosion.
text.Evini ve eşyalarını yangın, su baskını,: Protects your home and belongings against risks such as fire, flooding, theft and broken glass.
text.SGK’lı olarak anlaşmalı özel hastanelerd: Lets you, as someone insured with SGK (the Social Security Institution), receive treatment at contracted private hospitals without paying a difference fee.
text.Vefat ya da maluliyet durumunda sevdikle: Secures your loved ones' future and your loan debt in the event of death or disability.
text.Doğru teminat, uygun prim: The right coverage, an affordable premium
text.İhtiyacın olmayan teminatlara ödeme yapm: Choose only what you really need, without paying for coverage you don't.
text.Farklı şirketlerin tekliflerini karşılaş: Compare offers from different companies to find a policy that fits your budget.
text.Kimlik ve iletişim bilgilerinle tek form: Request a quote with your ID and contact details in a single form.
text.Konut ve taşıt kredin için istenen sigor: Get the insurance required for your home or vehicle loan in one place.
text.Sigorta, beklenmedik durumlara karşı fin: Insurance provides financial protection against unexpected events, safeguarding both your future and your family's. Risks such as health problems, traffic accidents, natural disasters or financial losses can be covered with the right policies.
text.Poliçeler ihtiyacına göre özelleştirileb: Policies can be customized to your needs. Home insurance protects your home against fire, theft and natural disasters, while kasko eases the financial burden that can arise from an accident. Health and life insurance, in turn, provide protection for treatment costs and your loved ones' future.
text.Poliçe seçerken nelere dikkat etmeli?: What should you look for when choosing a policy?
text.Poliçenin kapsamını ve istisnalarını dik: Review the policy's coverage and exclusions carefully. Keep in mind that pre-existing conditions may be excluded from health insurance coverage. At renewal, check for premium increases and changes in coverage, and choose the policy that best fits your needs.
text.Kredi kullanırken sigorta: Insurance when taking out a loan
text.Konut kredisinde teminat gösterilen ev i: For a home loan, DASK is mandatory for the home pledged as collateral; banks may also require home insurance. As long as it meets the coverage the bank requires, you can get your insurance from any company you like.
text.Sigorta ile Güvence Sağlamanın 5 Yolu: 5 Ways to Protect Yourself with Insurance
text.Evet. Zorunlu Deprem Sigortası (DASK), t: Yes. Compulsory Earthquake Insurance (DASK) is mandatory for homes registered in the land registry. A valid DASK policy is required for title deed transactions and for electricity and water subscriptions.
text.Trafik sigortası ile kasko arasındaki fa: What is the difference between traffic insurance and kasko?
text.Zorunlu trafik sigortası, kazada karşı t: Mandatory traffic insurance covers the damage you cause to the other party in an accident and is required for every vehicle. Kasko, on the other hand, is optional and covers damage to your own vehicle as well as risks such as theft.
text.Kredi kullanırken sigorta yaptırmak zoru: Do I have to get insurance when taking out a loan?
text.Konut kredisinde teminat olarak gösteril: For a home loan, DASK is mandatory for the home pledged as collateral; banks may also require home insurance. As long as it meets the coverage the bank requires, you can get your insurance from any insurance company you like.
text.Teklif talebimden sonra ne olur?: What happens after I request a quote?
text.Talebin bize ulaştıktan sonra seninle il: Once we receive your request, we'll get in touch with you, clarify the coverage you need and share insurance offers that suit you.
text.Sana uygun teklifi birlikte bulalım: Let's find the right offer for you together
text.Teklif talebini bırak, ihtiyacın olan te: Leave a quote request, and we'll clarify the coverage you need and share insurance offers that suit you.
